We compare our approach with four representative tag-image selection methods:
Middle Frame: naïve baseline selecting the central frame of the shot.
Pei et al. [3]: optical flow + HSV histogram based selection.
Zhang et al. [4]: multi-feature fusion using color, structure and motion.
Chen et al. [5]: object detection with image quality guided selection.
